🧪 NEET Interactive Lab

All four NEET subjects in one file — 111 working simulations with sliders, live explanations, formulas, labelled diagrams and practice questions. New in Chemistry: the interactive Periodic Table and Bonding Lab.

How to use

Pick a subject. Each subject opens exactly as its own lab: choose a topic from the list, move the sliders, and read what your change did. Use the 📚 Subjects button (bottom right) to switch subjects or come back here. Progress in each subject is saved on this device.
